quest.title: Lost in the Woods
quest.description: After having just arrived in Natlan, you are teleported to a strange space...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Reaffirmed Accord of Appellation x1

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, {TMPVALUE(TMP_VALUE_KEY_TYPE_LITTLE_DRILL_TMP_NAME)} isn't a bad name either... and it's a name Paimon came up with too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, big guy... You okay? Can you stand?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, it looks really weak. Ugh, seriously! Those floaty ghostly dogs are always up to no good... In fact, make that all things floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're fairly floaty, as floaty things go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's nothing like those guys!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, forget that for now. Let's see if we can get this guy something to eat, and then... We'll let it rest for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'll be feeling better soon, Paimon's sure of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No...

response.speaker: Big Guy?
response.text: ...*heavy breathing*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh no. It must be in so much pain, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Big Guy?
response.text: ...*heavy breathing*

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is... there something else that's on your mind?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there... Something you'd like to tell me?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Stretch... out your hand... Chosen of... Dragons... Reach out to me...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Join... strengths, and then... Witness all... and thus, liberate all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What's going on, {NICKNAME}? This is no time to zone out!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's nothing. Just a bit of a daze...

response.speaker: Big Guy?
response.text: ...Hrooo... Rrooo...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that your desire, or...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Reach out to the dying beast...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you doing... Err...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you...!

choices.text: You can rest now, big guy. You did good.
It's been holding out for far too long...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Ehrr... Rawr!

talks.objective: Shatter the rock and rescue the whelp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Then let's call this little fella {TMPVALUE(TMP_VALUE_KEY_TYPE_LITTLE_DRILL_TMP_NAME)}, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me think about this some more...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. Names are important, after all, so give it all the thought you need!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Are you alright there, little guy?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's wrong? You don't look so good. Is it your tail? Did you injure it when you fell from that barrier?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If only we could bandage it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's Paimon's time to shine! Your backpack's so full that even when it's an emergency, it still takes all day to find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's use this scarf from Paimon's Emergency Backpack instead!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have no clue where that backpack of yours is even supposed to be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Somewhere secret, somewhere safe, of course...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, do you wanna use the scarf or not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll use it. Thank you kindly, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Errr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, little guy, don't move...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe. Our little guy sure is well behaved, eh, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That should do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. Feel better now?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks way better now. That's a relief... Still, how did you end up in that barrier? And those Rifthounds...

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Errr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you don't know either, huh. Now, we don't really get what you're saying... But now that we've rescued you, you can go home.

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, do you not know where your home is?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about relatives, then? ...Oh, wait... That big guy from earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}? We can't just leave it here all by itself, right?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Wrroh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be better if you stay with us for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that makes sense. Maybe we'll find this little guy's family when we reach Natlan... But we've never seen anything like it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah. "Chosen of... Dragons..." Could that mean...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. You mean you heard something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Natlan is the "nation of dragons"... So, does that mean that... wait, they call little guys like this 'Saurians' around here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawoo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Paimon does see some resemblance to vishaps. Y'know... Two legs, one tail, and all.

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rraaa?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're happy to have it travel with us...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But we should ask our friend here if that's what it wants to do first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: True, true. Hey there, little guy. Would you like to travel with us?

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rrawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe! Looks like we're all agreed then. Anyway, Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Wrraa? Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, you need a name too... Let Paimon think. Right! Since you're yellow and brown all over, let's call you "Hash Brown"!

dialogues.speaker: Hash Brown?
dialogues.text: Rroooo... Rraaaa...

choices.text: I suspect that would only go down well at Good Hunter...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean people wouldn't like it anywhere else?

response.speaker: Little Guy?
response.text: Rroo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Would you like {NICKNAME} to give you a name, then? Well... not that Paimon can vouch for {M#his}{F#her} naming sense, though.

choices.text: All the names I've come up with so far have been perfectly normal, I'll have you know.
Poor little thing... to suffer such a calamitous fate.
Looks like it doesn't like that name...

talks.objective: Give the little one an awesome new name!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what should we call this little guy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. That'll be your name from now on, little guy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: ...Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like our little friend loves this name! Well, with any luck, we'll solve the mystery that surrounds you while we're in Natlan... Ah, and maybe we'll get some clues as to why {NICKNAME} was able to suddenly enter that Saurian's body...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh yeah, are you okay, by the way, {NICKNAME}? You suddenly turned into a Saurian back there... Are you feeling uncomfortable in any way?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that even supposed to mean!? This isn't the time for jokes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Still, {NICKNAME}, Paimon's never heard of anyone in Natlan who can turn into a Saurian... This is kinda weird.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously, we only just got here, and it feels like so much has already happened... Anyway, how do we get outta here?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? You know where the exit is?

choices.text: Becoming a Saurian for a bit was alright.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it'd best stay that way! Things could go south real fast if some day you were to turn into a Saurian and be unable to transform back...

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, there's some real power behind that name!

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, this name feels like it's piling the pressure on... Let's go with something else, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what should we call this little guy?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go with that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Little Guy?
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eh? You didn't like it when Paimon said "Hash Brown," but {NICKNAME} calls you "{TMPVALUE(TMP_VALUE_KEY_TYPE_LITTLE_DRILL_TMP_NAME)}" and now you're all happy and stuff? ...Ugh, never mind. No point being mad at you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, this name won't do at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Err, are you going to give it the same name as you, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, we're back here... Strange... the shining pillars from before are gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... Paimon's heard that there's a place called the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, and it's a major hub in Natlan. Maybe someone there might know what's happened to {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head there if we get the chance, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! Don't just suddenly go running off like that...
